question.text: How many confirmed U.S. measles cases for 2026 will CDC report in its November 27, 2026 update?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the national cumulative total of confirmed measles cases that the CDC reports for 2026 in the weekly update to its [Measles Cases and Outbreaks](https://www.cdc.gov/measles/data-research/index.html) page published on Friday, November 27, 2026, regardless of the data-cutoff ("as of") date that update uses. The value to be used is the page's national 2026 total — the figure in the statement "As of [date], X confirmed measles cases were reported in the United States in 2026," equivalently the 2026 "Total Cases" figure in the page's summary table — reported in whole cases (for example, the November 13, 2026 update showed 5,412 for 2026 and would resolve as 5,412). If no update is published on November 27, 2026, the first CDC update published after November 26, 2026 governs. If the page has since been overwritten by later weekly updates, the Internet Archive (web.archive.org) copy of the relevant update may be used to read the figure.
question.fine_print: Only CDC's own national 2026 total counts. Figures published by the Johns Hopkins US Measles Tracker, PAHO situation reports, individual state health departments, or news outlets do not count, even where they differ from CDC's. CDC's 2026 total includes confirmed cases among international visitors to the U.S. and cases reported by all jurisdictions, excludes probable cases reported by jurisdictions, and is subject to revision; the figure displayed in the governing update applies regardless of any later revision.

research:
## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-13 (data as of Nov 12): The CDC page reports **5,412 confirmed 2026 cases**. Of these, 5,394 came from 47 jurisdictions and 18 were international visitors. It also lists 43 new 2026 outbreaks, 96% of cases outbreak-associated (3,831 from 2026 outbreaks, 1,385 from outbreaks that began in 2025), and 6 deaths. [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/measles/data-research/index.html)
- The page blocks raw fetches (403), and the weekly rash-onset chart values aren't in the page text. I couldn't find a CSV or JSON file behind it.
- Updates use data as of noon ET Thursday and are usually published Friday. The next one is expected around Nov 20 (data as of Nov 19). [Contagion Live](https://www.contagionlive.com/view/measles-update-november-13-2026)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. Two weekly updates remain: about Nov 20 and the governing one, about Nov 27 (the Friday after Thanksgiving).
- As of today, 5,412 is the latest CDC figure.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-17: Taiwan CDC raised its US travel advisory to Level 2, citing more than 5,400 US cases. [UDN](https://udn.com/news/story/7266/9884076)
- 2026-11-17: IBTimes says CDC shows "nearly 5,500" cases in 47 jurisdictions and counts 10 deaths using state figures. CDC has not posted a number above 5,412, so this looks like loose wording. [IBTimes](https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/us-measles-deaths-elimination-status-vaccination-rates-1832702)
- 2026-11-16/17: A PAHO commission concluded US measles transmission is endemic again, and the formal announcement was set for Nov 17. This affects attention, not the counting itself. [US News](https://www.usnews.com/news/health-news/articles/2026-11-16/after-26-years-u-s-loses-its-measles-elimination-status-report-says), [Deseret](https://www.deseret.com/lifestyle/2026/11/16/us-loses-measles-elimination-status-outbreak-pan-american-health-organization/)
- 2026-11-16: Pennsylvania reported 1,561 cases, up 19 since Friday Nov 13 (1,542) and up 61 over 7 days. It also reported 310 hospitalizations and 7 deaths. The Nov 9 figure was 1,505. Pennsylvania's growth looks slower than earlier in the fall, at about 60 a week. [MarketScreener/Reuters](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/pennsylvania-measles-cases-rise-to-1-561-state-health-department-says-ce785edfdd8fff23), [Medscape](https://www.medscape.com/s/viewarticle/pennsylvania-wisconsin-report-measles-linked-deaths-cases-2026a10018fp)
- 2026-11-13: Wisconsin reported a second child death. On Nov 3 it had 431 cases. [GV Wire](https://gvwire.com/2026/11/05/wisconsin-reports-infant-death-linked-to-measles-outbreak/)
- Early Nov 2026: Minnesota cases are rising among unvaccinated patients. I found no statewide total. [Fox 9](https://www.fox9.com/news/minnesota-measles-cases-continue-rise-unvaccinated-patients-nov-2026.amp)

## 4. Base rates
- Recent CDC totals, with weekly change where it can be calculated:
  - Sep 10: 3,294
  - Sep 24: 3,659
  - Oct 1: 3,886
  - Oct 29: 4,852 (about +240 a week in October)
  - Nov 5: 5,182 (+330)
  - Nov 12: 5,412 (+230)
- That is 14 straight weeks of triple-digit increases.
- Over the last 6 weeks, increments have mostly been between 200 and 330 a week. Two more weeks at that pace gives about 5,810 to 6,070. At the low end, it is about 5,700 to 5,800.
- Seasonality and the holiday:
  - In 2025, CDC reported 1,723 cases as of Nov 13. A later week showed +84 (to 1,912), and the year ended at 2,065 as of Dec 30 (later revised to 2,289). Weekly growth stayed at roughly 50 to 100 through the Thanksgiving and December period. [CIDRAP](https://www.cidrap.umn.edu/measles/us-exceeds-1900-measles-cases-outbreaks-expand), [search results](https://laist.com/news/health/us-measles-cases-hit-highest-level-in-33-years-cdc-reports)
  - I couldn't confirm whether CDC published on schedule during Thanksgiving week 2025. It was publishing on Wednesdays then, so Nov 26, 2025 would have been the date.
  - Years before 2025 had very few cases in November, so they aren't useful comparisons.
- This year is running about 3 times the 2025 level for the same calendar point.
- Holiday reporting lags could shrink the Nov 27 increment. Late revisions or catch-up could also make it larger.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket, "Measles cases in U.S. by November 30?": 5,600+ at 97.3%, 5,800+ at 91.5%, 6,000+ at 54% (prices as of 2026-11-17). This closely matches the question, but its resolution date (Nov 30) and source rules may differ slightly. [Polymarket]
- Kalshi, 2026 full-year: Above 6,000 at 98%, Above 7,000 at 78%, Above 8,000 at 20%. This is a full-year total, so it only gives an upper anchor.
- Manifold: none on this exact number.
- No expert model forecasts were found.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- About Fri Nov 20: CDC update with data as of Nov 19.
- Thu Nov 26: Thanksgiving. The update about Nov 27 could be delayed, published early (Wed Nov 25), or use a shifted cutoff. If none is published on Nov 27, the first update after Nov 26 governs, which could be early December.
- State updates are leading indicators: Pennsylvania (about 60 a week lately), Wisconsin, Minnesota, and South Carolina.
- The PAHO announcement (Nov 17) could increase testing or reporting attention.
- Weather isn't relevant.

Sources: [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/measles/data-research/index.html), [Contagion Live Nov 13](https://www.contagionlive.com/view/measles-update-november-13-2026), [Contagion Live Nov 6](https://www.contagionlive.com/view/measles-update-november-6-2026), [SRN News](https://srnnews.com/us-measles-cases-rise-to-5412-cdc-says/), [2 Minute Medicine](https://www.2minutemedicine.com/cdc-reports-5412-confirmed-measles-cases-in-the-united-states-in-2026/), [US News](https://www.usnews.com/news/health-news/articles/2026-11-16/after-26-years-u-s-loses-its-measles-elimination-status-report-says), [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/pennsylvania-measles-cases-rise-to-1-561-state-health-department-says-ce785edfdd8fff23), [Medscape](https://www.medscape.com/s/viewarticle/pennsylvania-wisconsin-report-measles-linked-deaths-cases-2026a10018fp), [GV Wire](https://gvwire.com/2026/11/05/wisconsin-reports-infant-death-linked-to-measles-outbreak/), [Fox 9](https://www.fox9.com/news/minnesota-measles-cases-continue-rise-unvaccinated-patients-nov-2026.amp), [CIDRAP](https://www.cidrap.umn.edu/measles/us-exceeds-1900-measles-cases-outbreaks-expand), [LAist](https://laist.com/news/health/us-measles-cases-hit-highest-level-in-33-years-cdc-reports), [IBTimes](https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/us-measles-deaths-elimination-status-vaccination-rates-1832702), [UDN](https://udn.com/news/story/7266/9884076), [Deseret](https://www.deseret.com/lifestyle/2026/11/16/us-loses-measles-elimination-status-outbreak-pan-american-health-organization/)

## 1. Resolution source

- 2026-11-17: I couldn't read the CDC page directly. Both the page and its data file (/wcms/vizdata/measles/…json) returned "403 Access Denied" to my tool. [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/measles/data-research/index.html)
- 2026-11-13: The latest CDC update, with data as of Nov 12, shows **5,412** confirmed 2026 cases. That is up 230 (4.4%) from 5,182. It includes 18 cases among international visitors and 5,394 domestic cases from 47 jurisdictions. There were 43 outbreaks, none new that week, and 96% of cases were outbreak-associated. CDC lists 6 deaths. [Contagion Live](https://www.contagionlive.com/view/measles-update-november-13-2026)
- The next CDC update is expected about Fri Nov 20, with data as of Nov 19. Nothing had been published as of today.

## 2. Current status

- Nothing has settled the question yet. The governing figure is still at least one, probably two, weekly updates away.
- **A key timing risk:** in 2025, CDC published the Thanksgiving-week update early, on **Wednesday Nov 26, 2025**, with data as of Nov 25 ([Prism News](https://www.prismnews.com/news/measles-cases-surge-to-nearly-1800-outbreaks-strike-43-jurisdictions)). If CDC does the same in 2026 and publishes on Wed Nov 25, nothing would be published on Nov 27. The rules say the first update published *after* Nov 26 then governs. That would likely be about Dec 4, adding roughly one more week of cases. If CDC skips the holiday week entirely, the next update governs. The Polymarket "by November 30" market resolves on a different basis.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)

- 2026-11-17: Taiwan CDC raised its US travel advisory to Level 2, citing more than 5,400 US cases. [UDN](https://udn.com/news/story/7266/9884076)
- 2026-11-17: IBTimes says CDC shows "nearly 5,500" cases and 10 deaths nationally. This is likely a mix of state and CDC counts; I couldn't verify it against a new CDC release. [IBTimes](https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/us-measles-deaths-elimination-status-vaccination-rates-1832702)
- 2026-11-15/17: A PAHO commission concluded that measles transmission is endemic in the US, so the US loses elimination status. The formal announcement is set for Nov 17. [Deseret](https://www.deseret.com/lifestyle/2026/11/16/us-loses-measles-elimination-status-outbreak-pan-american-health-organization/), [Maryland Matters](https://marylandmatters.org/2026/11/15/repub/us-loses-its-measles-elimination-status-after-more-than-25-years/)
- 2026-11-16: Pennsylvania reached 1,561 cases (+19 since Friday, +61 over 7 days), with 310 hospitalizations and 7 deaths. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/pennsylvania-measles-cases-rise-to-1-561-state-health-department-says-ce785edfdd8fff23)
- 2026-11-13: Pennsylvania was at 1,542 cases. Wisconsin reported its 2nd death and at least 649 cases in 20 counties. [Medscape](https://www.medscape.com/s/viewarticle/pennsylvania-wisconsin-report-measles-linked-deaths-cases-2026a10018fp)
- Mid-Nov 2026: Minnesota reported 59 new cases in one week, 139 since mid-September, centred on Todd County. [Fox9](https://www.fox9.com/news/minnesota-measles-cases-continue-rise-unvaccinated-patients-nov-2026.amp)
- Pennsylvania's own weekly pace (about 61 a week) is slower than earlier, which suggests national growth is now spread across several states.

## 4. Base rates and trend

- CDC weekly totals in 2026:
  - Sep 10: 3,294
  - Sep 24: 3,659
  - Oct 1: 3,886
  - About Oct 22: 4,588 ([Medical Daily](https://medicaldaily.com/us-measles-4588-cases-paho-elimination-review-november-480442))
  - Oct 29: 4,852 (+264)
  - Nov 5: 5,182 (+330)
  - Nov 12: 5,412 (+230)
- The average from Oct 1 to Nov 12 was about 254 a week. The last 6 weeks ran roughly 200 to 330 a week.
- Simple extrapolation (my arithmetic, not a forecast):
  - Two more weeks at 200 to 330 a week gives about 5,810 to 6,070.
  - If the governing update slips to about Dec 4, three weeks gives about 6,010 to 6,400.
- Seasonality and the holiday, same period in 2025:
  - 2025-11-18: 1,753
  - 2025-11-25: 1,798, published Wed Nov 26. That is +45, a small Thanksgiving-week increment.
  - 2025-12-16: 1,958 ([Contagion Live](https://www.contagionlive.com/view/us-measles-cases-near-2-000-in-2025-as-multi-state-outbreaks-expand))
  - The 2025 growth rate was far lower in absolute terms. 2026 is running about 3 times the 2025 level, with weekly increments about 4 to 5 times larger.
- I couldn't find comparable Nov 17 to Nov 27 values for 2022 to 2024. Those were low-case years, with only a few cases a week.
- Measles in the US usually peaks in late winter and spring. The autumn 2026 surge is driven by outbreaks rather than by season.

## 5. Other forecasts

- Polymarket, "Measles cases in U.S. by November 30?" ([Polymarket](https://polymarket.com)). This is the closest match, though its timing and source rules may differ:
  - 5,600+: 97.3%
  - 5,800+: 91.5%
  - 6,000+: 54%
- Kalshi full-year 2026 market:
  - Above 6,000: 98%
  - Above 7,000: 78%
  - Above 8,000: 20%
  - That implies an end-of-year total of about 7,000 to 8,000, consistent with about 250 to 400 a week through December.
- Manifold: "twice 2025" is at 100%. No market matches this exact question.
- Johns Hopkins showed 5,400 as of Nov 6. It runs ahead of CDC, though it does not count for resolution.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution

- About Fri Nov 20: CDC weekly update (data as of Nov 19).
- Thanksgiving week: CDC could publish on Wed Nov 25 (as in 2025), on Fri Nov 27, or skip the week. As section 2 explains, this decides which figure governs.
- Mon/Fri updates from Pennsylvania, plus the Wisconsin and Minnesota weekly reports. These lead the CDC numbers by a few days.
- Nov 17: formal PAHO announcement. It could prompt more testing and reporting, but has no direct effect on the count.
- Holiday reporting lags could push the Thanksgiving-week increment down, as happened in 2025 (+45).
- Weather is not relevant.
